response_geometry: One generated response coordinate is assigned to each of the three modules. The third coordinate is a fixed linear combination of the two preliminary generated coordinates plus independent noise, with its generating coefficient transformed identically. This pilot validates complete-family assembly and minimally resolves the first Holm threshold; it does not validate the final multicoordinate colour or gross-shape geometry.
family_rule: For every outer dataset and grid, use one paired crossed bootstrap to preserve cross-module dependence, derive each module-process-scale candidate probability from the corresponding response coordinate, fill all 36 planned slots, then apply the frozen holm_complete_family rule. No missing slot is replaced and no favourable grid is selected.
qualification_boundary: 999 planned draws give plus-one tail resolution 0.001, sufficient to cross the first 0.05/36 Holm threshold but still coarse. Eight outer replicates per scenario cannot estimate FWER or coverage precisely, and one-coordinate synthetic modules do not reproduce final colour/shape dimensionality. This is an executable family-mechanics and tail-resolution pilot only. It cannot authorize empirical trait-environment fitting regardless of outcome. A later adequately replicated calibration using the final module geometry and realized-cohort nuisance/rank support remains required.
